briefs.hook_script: Most people think a deep scratch down to the primer means an expensive trip to the body shop, or worse, a full panel respray. I’m going to show you how I fixed this deep gouge in my own driveway using stuff you can find at any local hardware store, and honestly, you won't even be able to tell where the scratch was.
